grades_state_score_check.name: grades_state_score_check
grades_state_score_check.value: ("grades"."state" = 'VALID' AND "grades"."score" IS NOT NULL) OR ("grades"."state" <> 'VALID' AND "grades"."score" IS NULL)

result_publications_result_type_check.name: result_publications_result_type_check
result_publications_result_type_check.value:
(
        ("result_publications"."result_type" = 'SUBJECT' AND "result_publications"."subject_result_id" IS NOT NULL AND "result_publications"."period_result_id" IS NULL AND "result_publications"."annual_result_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("result_publications"."result_type" = 'PERIOD' AND "result_publications"."period_result_id" IS NOT NULL AND "result_publications"."subject_result_id" IS NULL AND "result_publications"."annual_result_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("result_publications"."result_type" = 'ANNUAL' AND "result_publications"."annual_result_id" IS NOT NULL AND "result_publications"."subject_result_id" IS NULL AND "result_publications"."period_result_id" IS NULL)
      )

result_publications_period_column_check.name: result_publications_period_column_check
result_publications_period_column_check.value:
(
        ("result_publications"."result_type" = 'ANNUAL' AND "result_publications"."academic_period_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("result_publications"."result_type" <> 'ANNUAL' AND "result_publications"."academic_period_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

announcement_publications_status_timesta.name: announcement_publications_status_timestamps_check
announcement_publications_status_timesta.value:
(
        ("announcement_publications"."status" = 'PUBLISHED' AND "announcement_publications"."published_at" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("announcement_publications"."status" = 'SCHEDULED' AND "announcement_publications"."published_at" IS NULL AND "announcement_publications"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

announcement_publications_schedule_order.name: announcement_publications_schedule_order_check
announcement_publications_schedule_order.value: "announcement_publications"."scheduled_at" IS NULL OR "announcement_publications"."published_at" IS NULL OR "announcement_publications"."scheduled_at" <= "announcement_publications"."published_at"

announcement_targets_type_class_check.name: announcement_targets_type_class_check
announcement_targets_type_class_check.value:
(
        ("announcement_targets"."target_type" = 'CLASS' AND "announcement_targets"."class_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("announcement_targets"."target_type" = 'SCHOOL' AND "announcement_targets"."class_id" IS NULL)
      )

publication_recipient_snapshots_audience.name: publication_recipient_snapshots_audiences_check
publication_recipient_snapshots_audience.value:
(
        jsonb_typeof("publication_recipient_snapshots"."audiences") = 'array'
        AND (
          "publication_recipient_snapshots"."audiences" = CAST('["PARENTS"]' AS jsonb)
          OR "publication_recipient_snapshots"."audiences" = CAST('["TEACHERS"]' AS jsonb)
          OR "publication_recipient_snapshots"."audiences" = CAST('["PARENTS","TEACHERS"]' AS jsonb)
          OR "publication_recipient_snapshots"."audiences" = CAST('["TEACHERS","PARENTS"]' AS jsonb)
        )
      )
